name: bergbot-find
title_zh: 2~3 条候选徒步路线，先按你的条件排好序再帮你挑刺
tagline_zh: 说人话就出路线：地区、日期、爬升、时长、狗、小孩、环线……它先筛再排，你挑一条，它逐项核对。
tagline_en: Speak naturally, get ranked trails by region, date, ascent, duration, dog, kids, loop, transit time. Pick one, it.
desc_en: Find 2–3 hikes from constraints in natural language (region/canton, date, max ascent, distance, duration, T-grade, transport origin and travel time, hut, dog, kids, loop) and rank them by conditions; then audit the one the user picks. Use for "generate/find/suggest a hike …".
why_zh: 不是关键词匹配，而是把模糊需求（如“轻松”）翻译成可量化条件，再按满足度排序。
why_en: It interprets vague asks like 'easy' into measurable filters, ranks by fit, then audits your pick—catching trails that look fine.
limit_zh: 只认瑞士远足数据（含T级、交通），别的国家直接失效；不生成路线，只从现有库中筛选；若输入缺日期或区域，会要求补全。
limit_en: Swiss hiking data only (incl. T-grades, transit); no route creation—filters existing trails. Missing date/region triggers clarification, no guessing.
title_en: 2-3 hike picks ranked by your constraints, then audited
